intendedMeaning: A cyan lightning channel reaches the ground and causes a warm localized explosion and cooling smoke at the same horizontal position.
observedFirstImpression: In the sampled native frames, an already connected cyan lightning channel is followed by a warm pointed starburst at its lower endpoint, then separate overlapping circular smoke puffs.

observations.observed: At frame 3 (0.1 seconds) the lightning is already continuous to the lower contact, with visible contact glow. The response cue starts at 0.32 seconds as authored. The samples therefore do not support the intent's precise claim that the channel first arrives at 0.32 seconds.
observations.scope: The existing focused-arc source draws the early complete channel; this is a source-artwork/intent mismatch rather than evidence of an incorrectly scheduled response cue.
observations.nextCheck: View the generated MP4 at normal speed and decide whether the source should progressively propagate to the contact, or whether the authored event should explicitly represent a delayed discharge after a channel has formed. No source artwork or intent was silently changed during this review.

observations.observed: The gold, orange and red pointed blast occupies the lower-center position shared with the lightning endpoint. The lightning overlaps the blast's upper-left side. A thin ground ellipse and small debris pixels remain below the bright body. The blast reads as a graphic starburst in these stills.
observations.scope: This confirms sampled spatial overlap and visible shape, not motion quality, physical realism or an artistic approval.

observations.observed: At 1.8 seconds the bright blast is gone and several purple-gray circular puffs remain. Their individual circles are obvious at native size; a continuous volumetric plume is not established by this sample.
No visible canvas-edge clipping appears in the viewed samples. The final sampled frame at 2.733 seconds is visually empty against the black background and has zero occupied raw color cells.
observations.scope: Sampled review only. Native color bounds do not measure every glow pixel and do not certify all intervening frames.

limitations: Full-speed playback has been generated and its encoding metadata checked, but has not been visually inspected.
